rychly_test.title: Quick test
rychly_test.vazne_a: The questions are built around real scam patterns that surfaced in Slovakia in recent months. It's not a security audit, but send it to your parents or colleagues — you'll see where their weak spot is.
rychly_test.podvadzanie_a: Try it. The timer's running, the questions are shuffled, you won't have time to google. We'll see who's smarter.
rychly_test.vysledok_q: What do I get when the test is done?
rychly_test.vysledok_a: Score, a category (Seasoned / Alert / Vulnerable / Easy prey) and a per-question breakdown with explanations. You can save the result as an image or share it — it never reveals your specific answers.

testy.title: Tests
testy.testy_a_prefix: Ready-made question sets tailored to a specific industry. An e-shop gets questions about fake orders, hospitality about fake inspections, IT about BEC fraud. Just share the link with your team — each person gets their own result.
testy.demograficke_q: Are there tests for ordinary people, not just companies?
testy.demograficke_a_prefix: Yes — we have sets for under-16s (gaming and school scams), students (fake rentals, fake scholarships), seniors (AI voice cloning, doorstep scams) and a general test for everyone. You'll find them in the

skolenia.title: Courses
skolenia.co_a_prefix: Short articles with Slovak scenarios for each type of scam — phishing, smishing, vishing, BEC, marketplace, investment and romance scams, password hygiene. You can read them in any order in the
skolenia.co_a_suffix: ; they are not behind a paywall.
skolenia.odbornik_q: Do I need to be an IT expert?
skolenia.odbornik_a: No. The courses are written equally for an office administrator, a receptionist, a pensioner and a sixth-former. No jargon without an explanation.

bezpecnost.title: Security and privacy
bezpecnost.data_q: What data do you store about me?
bezpecnost.data_a_prefix: Only your answers and score — anonymously, with no name, no e-mail and no IP address. Details are in the
bezpecnost.cookies_a_prefix: We only use strictly necessary cookies (session, consent). We don't run analytics or advertising cookies without your explicit consent. You can change or revoke your settings at any time via the "Manage cookies" banner in the page footer or in the
bezpecnost.zmazanie_a: Yes. Your anonymous result is tied only to a session ID in your browser — not to your identity. Just clear your browser cookies and local storage (Settings → Privacy → Clear browsing data). If you used a shareable link, get in touch via the Contact page in the footer and we'll remove that specific record.

about.title: What subenai is
about.tagline: A free educational tool for the Slovak digital world.
about.ciel_p1: Educate the public about digital fraud — phishing, smishing, vishing, BEC, investment scams, romance scams, marketplace fraud. Every Slovak citizen should be able to recognise common scam patterns without needing an IT background.
about.ciel_p2: Measurable impact: number of test completions, population-level categories of discovered weak spots, content updates driven by what people actually fail in the tests.
about.bezplatne_p1_prefix: A paywall would narrow the audience down to exactly those who don't need the help. The most vulnerable demographic — seniors, pensioners, non-technical users — would never reach the content. The project's mission is
about.bezplatne_p2: No free tier vs. premium tier. Every question, every course, every result is accessible to anyone without registration.
about.sponsorship_p1_prefix: The donation model keeps the legal picture clean — no paid service, simpler bookkeeping, no consumer disputes over "insufficient product quality". Sponsors receive
about.sponsorship_p2: We don't want to split users into two classes. A sponsor and an anonymous visitor get exactly the same content. That's a deliberate trade-off: it's what lets the project stay free for everyone.

skoly.meta_title: For schools and educational institutions — subenai
skoly.meta_description: How to prepare an edu test for a class or team, share it safely and open the results. Password, GDPR author role, 12-month retention, CSV export.
skoly.title: For schools, trainers and HR
skoly.hero: Edu mode in Composer lets you prepare a test for a class or team, collect responses with the respondent's name and e-mail, and view the results via a password-protected dashboard. No accounts, no registration. Free.
skoly.what_body_prefix: Edu mode is an opt-in layer on top of
skoly.what_body_suffix: . It's used by teachers (grading a test for a class), trainers (a post-training check) or HR (employee onboarding). In standard mode responses are fully anonymous — edu mode is the exception where the respondent knowingly hands their name and e-mail to the test author.
skoly.step1_li1_suffix: and pick predefined sets or assemble questions by hand.
skoly.step1_li2: Set the pass threshold (default 70 %) and number of questions (5–50).
skoly.step2_heading: Step 2: Turn on edu mode and password
skoly.step2_p1_middle: section, switch on "Collect responses with name and e-mail" and enter a
skoly.step2_p1_middle2: (min. 8 characters). The password is your only way back to the results — we store only a bcrypt hash, the original is kept nowhere.
skoly.step2_p2_suffix: a dialog appears with three fields: the respondent link, the results link and the password. Copy all three (a password manager is ideal) BEFORE you close the dialog.
skoly.step3_heading: Step 3: Send the link to respondents
skoly.step3_p_suffix: (public). Students / colleagues see an intake form — they enter name, e-mail and explicitly agree to the processing of personal data. Without consent the test does not start.
skoly.step4_p_suffix: , enter the password and you'll see:
skoly.step4_li1: Summary: number of respondents, average, min/max, median, pass rate.
skoly.step4_li3: Respondent table with sorting and search.
skoly.step4_li4: Option to delete a specific respondent (confirmation + audit log).
skoly.step4_li5_suffix: of all responses for offline analysis (Excel, Google Sheets).
skoly.step4_session: The session lasts 60 minutes. After it expires the password prompt returns. Brute-force protection: 5 attempts / 15 min / IP / test.
skoly.gdpr_p_prefix: When collecting name and e-mail you are
skoly.gdpr_p_middle: (Art. 4(7) GDPR) — you set the purpose and means.
skoly.gdpr_p_suffix: (Art. 28 GDPR) — we host the data on your instruction and delete it on your instruction.
skoly.gdpr_li1_suffix: 12 months from creation of the record, after which we automatically anonymise name + e-mail. Score + responses remain for your statistics.
skoly.gdpr_li2_suffix: they turn to you (the controller) — access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17). We help you fulfil them via the dashboard (delete a respondent in one click).
skoly.gdpr_li3_suffix: if a school or company asks for a formal processing agreement, write to us at
skoly.gdpr_li4_prefix: the intake form mentions the author (suite name), states the 12-month retention and links to the
skoly.gdpr_li4_suffix: . This is something you don't have to worry about — it comes included.
skoly.faq_pwd_q: I lost the password. Can you reset it?
skoly.faq_pwd_a: No. We only store the password as a bcrypt hash, we don't have the original. Create a new edu test and share a new link — sadly the old results are lost.
skoly.faq_retention_a: Respondent name + e-mail = 12 months, then auto-anonymisation. Score and answer detail remain for your statistics.
skoly.faq_delete_q: Can I delete a specific student?
skoly.faq_delete_a: Yes. In the dashboard (results link) click the bin icon next to their row — confirm and the row is gone permanently.
skoly.faq_max_q: How many respondents can take a single test?
skoly.faq_max_a: Max 50 attempts / hour / test (anti-spam). In practice that's enough for a class or team; split larger collections across multiple suites.
skoly.faq_retake_q: Can a student sign in repeatedly?
skoly.faq_retake_a: No — one e-mail = one record. If you really need a retest, delete the old record in the dashboard and the student can sign in again.
skoly.faq_mobile_a: Yes, both the intake form and the dashboard are mobile-first.
